caption: The drawing depicts a large stein or tankard with a lid, illustrated in pencil or graphite on a light beige background. The central object is a cylindrical vessel with a domed lid and an ornate finial on top. The front of the vessel features a shield-shaped crest, which contains a decorative emblem: a lion or similar animal above three stars and two crossed swords. Below the crest, in cursive, are the initials "HW." Above and slightly to the left is a small inset diagram showing a side view of the stein with measurements; above and to the right is a second small inset showing a decorative form marked “L.W.” The main drawing is framed by a faint rectangular border, and in the bottom left corner outside the border, the name "HANS WESTENDORF" is printed in uppercase letters. The entire composition is rendered in monochrome shades of gray, with subtle shading used to suggest the metallic sheen and roundness of the vessel.
title: Silver Tankard
